net.ipHint: Press lookup to ask ipapi.co for your public address.
net.ipFailed: Lookup failed (ad blocker or rate limit).
net.localHint: Press discover. Modern browsers return an mDNS .local name instead of a real LAN address — that is privacy protection, not a fault.
net.limitsBody: A browser tab is a sandbox. These are impossible from here — by any trick:
net.limit.scan: Port scanning or discovering devices on the local network
net.limit.monitor: Monitor mode or packet capture from a network adapter
net.limit.arp: Reading the ARP table, neighbours or routing entries
net.limit.switch: Configuring a switch/VLAN or reaching a management interface
net.limitsFix: Those need Kali on real hardware, a VM or a Raspberry Pi. Yairos is the notebook and the lessons — not the tool itself.
